remarks: Here's a handyman special located on a coveted mid city cul de sac perched high offering panoramic sunset views in addition to enhanced rear yard privacy. Main level has 3 bedrooms, one full bath, hardwood floors and a window walled seasonal room right off the kitchen and dining room which adds an additional 221 square feet of living space and offers grand possibilities. The lower level includes 2 more bedrooms and two large open rooms one with a oversized bay window and French doors out to the deck, private rear yard and brick patio, the laundry room, powder room and garage access. The lower level offers wonderful possibilities for many different uses. The shed on the property has double doors for easy added storage. New front steps and railing 2025, roof replaced in 2018, boiler and hot water heater replaced 2014. You'll want to put your personal touches on the spaces here to make it shine again and in this location it'll be well worth the effort. Strictly an "as is" sale.
